assets.alt: 旅行者查看无字地图并好奇探索老城的小巷
assets.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational
Asset type: one square illustration for an English vocabulary memory card.
Exact target sense: "explore" / v. / "探索".
Sense context (not image text): We spent the afternoon exploring the old town. 我们花了一下午探索这座老城。
Primary request: depict only this exact sense in a concrete readable scene.
Scene: One curious traveler actively explores an old town on foot: holding a small folded map with only simple street lines and no writing, leaning to look around the next corner of a charming narrow stone lane. Their head turns attentively toward an unfamiliar arched passage. A few simple old buildings suggest several places left to investigate, but the traveler and active looking are central. This is investigating an unfamiliar place, not simply commuting.
Style/medium: hand-painted gouache with subtle colored-pencil texture on warm off-white paper, soft daylight, natural muted green, blue and coral, matching gentle garden vocabulary illustrations.
Composition: one coherent tightly related scene centered within the middle 70 percent, generous empty paper margins, main subjects entirely visible and clear at small card size.
Constraints: no written words, letters, numbers, labels, logos, watermarks, borders, arrows, card UI or generic stock icons. No unrelated objects.
